An Outstanding Vegetarian Dining Experience
Jul 2026 • Solo
Everything I ordered from this restaurant was absolutely delicious. The first dish I tried was the Phở cuốn. I really liked the simplicity of this dish while still finding it vibrant and flavorful. The rice wrapper was soft and chewy, the fillings were fresh, and the mushrooms were cooked well. Every bite felt satisfying, and the sweet and sour dipping sauce complemented the rolls perfectly.

Next, I had their signature Chay Garden salad (Gỏi nấm khoai môn sốt chanh dây). This was incredibly savory and probably one of the best salads I have ever tasted. I loved the variety of textures throughout the dish; Some ingredients were crunchy while others were soft. The passion fruit dressing was well-balanced and never overwhelming. I especially enjoyed eating the salad with the crispy rice cracker, which added another satisfying layer of texture.

I also ordered the sweet potato balls (Bánh khoai lang tím nhân phô mai tan chảy). The mozzarella cheese was perfectly gooey, and the sweet potato filling was smooth, though not quite creamy. While the dish was delicious, it felt more like a dessert than an appetizer because of its sweetness. I also did not notice any mushrooms in the filling, despite them being listed on the menu. The exterior could have been crispier, but my biggest issue was the accompanying sriracha sauce. In my opinion, the spicy heat overpowered the earthy sweetness of the sweet potato instead of complementing it. Although it was a nice snack, I don't think it was worth 159,000 VND.

Lastly, I tried the banana flambé cake (Bánh chuối đốt kiểu vườn Chay, dùng kèm nước cốt dừa). I actually had low expectations after the sweet potato balls, but this dessert exceeded them. The cake itself was already rich and indulgent, but adding the coconut milk elevated it even further. I also appreciated that it was served hot. The flambé was executed perfectly, giving the bananas a wonderful caramelized flavor that paired with the creamy coconut milk. The bananas were ripe and sweet, and even the coconut milk was delicious on its own. This was an outstanding dessert and the perfect ending to the meal.

Overall, Chay Garden delivered an excellent dining experience. Every dish was nicely prepared, the ambiance was relaxing, and the service was fast and attentive. I would definitely return and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for high-quality vegetarian Vietnamese cuisine.
